spans.s: [Maurin, n. sg. Maurī, printed in text of Laṅk 〔362.11〕 pāṇḍavāḥ kauravā rāma paścān maurī bhaviṣyati. Tho ed. note says that Tib. and Chin. support this reading, the Skt. mss. read saurī, and this or śauriḥ is surely to be read (Skt. Śauriḥ = Kṛṣṇaḥ). The reading with m for s, or ś, is due to anticipation of the name mauryā(ḥ) in the next line; see the following entry.]
(Maurya, = Skt. id., family name of the emperor Aśoka, q.v.: Divy 〔381.20, 26〕; 〔405.6〕; pl., n. of the dynasty, Laṅk 〔362.12〕 ˚yā nandāś ca guptāś ca.)
